coverageNotes: Covers generated API module/export addressing. Does not measure CRUD implementation, missing-document policy or indexes.

questions.context: Convex 1.44.0. `convex/users.ts` exports a public query `get` taking `{ id: Id<"users"> }`. `convex/posts.ts` exports a public query `get` taking `{ id: Id<"posts"> }`. Both return the matching document. A client imports the generated `api`; `postId` is a valid post ID.
questions.question: Which call invokes the posts query?

options.rationale: This reverses the module and exported function names.
Generated module references omit the .ts extension.
The module name posts and exported name get form api.posts.get.
This invokes the users query, whose validator rejects a post ID.
